title: Signed line PullbackNaturality
statement: For rank-one P,Q and a normalized family T [def-pur-signed-line-pullback-normalization-data], the family commutes with every compatible pair of line isomorphisms and with arbitrary compatible extensions R→R′ and S→S′ of coefficient rings. In negative degrees the isomorphism maps are inverse precomposition on internal Hom. The scalar squares use the specified signed scalar comparisons and impose no flatness condition on either ring map.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: For a compatible line isomorphism square, prove positive naturality by degree-zero normalization, the degree-one square, and tensor recursion. For negative powers use evaluation pairing-transfer uniqueness and cancel the dual isomorphism.

A scalar extension of a rank-one line remains rank one: transport its trivializing charts using the explicit scalar comparison, with no flatness assumption. Apply the normalized signed scalar/pullback-square theorem and use normalized uniqueness to identify its families with the supplied families.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.

theorem signed_line_pullback_naturality
    [HasFiniteLimits C] [HasFiniteLimits D] [PreservesFiniteLimits U]
    (_hcover : CoverPreserving J K U)
    [∀ V : C, (J.over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}]
    [∀ V : D, (K.over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}]
    (rInv : Sheaf J RingCat.{max u v w} ⥤ Sheaf K RingCat.{max u v w})
    (rAdj : rInv ⊣ U.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K)
    (_ha : IsIso ((rAdj.homEquiv _ _).symm a))
    (_hP : ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → C), J.CoversTop V ∧
      ∀ i : I, Nonempty (P.over (V i) ≅
        unit (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).over (V i))))
    (_hQ : ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → D), K.CoversTop V ∧
      ∀ i : I, Nonempty (Q.over (V i) ≅
        unit (((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S).over (V i))))
    (T : ∀ d : ℤ, (pull a).obj (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P d) ≅
      signedLinePower.{u, v, w} Q d)
    (_hT : SignedLinePullbackNormalized a P Q t T) :
    IsoNaturality a P Q t T ∧ ScalarNaturality a P Q t rInv rAdj T
